name: Raj Creations - WhatsApp Lead Funnel v2
description: Fixed copy of the WhatsApp lead funnel: template alerts for Mahek, smarter intent and amount parsing, voice/doc handling, pause & throttling, duplicate/burst protection, retries.

parameters.content:
## Before switching this on
1. Add two column headers to the leads sheet (Sheet1): **paused_until** and **last_alert_at**.
2. Create + get approval for WhatsApp template **rc_sales_alert** (until approved, alerts fall back to plain text, which only reaches Mahek if she messaged the bot in the last 24 h).
3. Turn OFF the old "Raj Creations - WhatsApp Lead Funnel" first, then turn this one on (only one WhatsApp trigger can be live).

Mahek can text the bot number: **pause 91XXXXXXXXXX**, **resume 91XXXXXXXXXX**, **status 91XXXXXXXXXX**.

parameters.jsCode:
// One row of the "Orders" tab in the leads sheet.
const o = $('Build Context').first().json.order_save;
const LANGS = { hi: 'Hindi', gu: 'Gujarati', ta: 'Tamil', te: 'Telugu', en: 'English' };
const ship = Number(o.shipping);
return [{ json: {
  'Order ID': o.order_id,
  'Status': o.status === 'confirmed' ? 'Confirmed' : o.status === 'updated' ? 'Updated by customer' : o.status === 'cancelled' ? 'Cancelled' : 'New',
  'Order date': o.created_at || '',
  'Customer': o.name || '',
  'Phone': o.phone ? '+' + o.phone : '',
  'Shop': o.shop || '',
  'City': o.city || '',
  'Business type': o.btype || '',
  'Price level': o.level || '',
  'Language': LANGS[o.lang] || o.lang || '',
  'Items': o.lines_text || '',
  'Packets / boxes': o.packets,
  'Dozens': o.dozens,
  'Items total': o.items_total,
  'Handling': o.handling || 0,
  'GST': o.gst,
  'Total incl. GST': o.total,
  'Shipping': ship >= 0 ? ship : 'not set',
  'Grand total': o.grand_total || '',
  'Confirmed at': o.confirmed_at || '',
  'PDF sent at': o.pdf_sent_at || '',
  'Updated at': o.updated_at || '',
  'Version': o.version || 1,
  'Notes': o.note || '',
  'Chat': o.phone ? 'https://wa.me/' + o.phone : '',
} }];
